sentences.text: Agathobaculum butyriciproducens was described from strain SR79, isolated from a Korean faecal sample.
It is a strictly anaerobic, Gram-stain-positive, non-spore-forming, non-motile short rod that produces butyric acid as a major end product.
The genus Agathobaculum is one of the Oscillospiraceae lineages, a family of prominent anaerobic gut bacteria that includes many butyrate producers.
In mouse experiments, strain SR79 improved cognition and reduced Alzheimer's disease pathology and showed neuroprotective effects in a Parkinson's disease model.
